description:
## Why

PKIX-jbvb was filed during the 2026-05-11 audit as 'pkix-profiles: CA/B Forum S/MIME BR sub-profile families (Organization-/Sponsor-/Individual-validated).' Under the new framework-not-policy stance (PKIX-amgn), that work belongs in `pkix-profiles-cabf`, not `pkix-profiles` proper, and its framing changes from 'canonical implementation' to 'reference, not authoritative.'

## What

1. Rewrite PKIX-jbvb's description to target `pkix-profiles-cabf` instead of `pkix-profiles`.
2. Update the bead's title accordingly: 'pkix-profiles-cabf: S/MIME BR sub-profile families (Organization-/Sponsor-/Individual-validated)'.
3. Add the not-authoritative framing into the bead's acceptance criteria — each new profile type must carry the same rustdoc disclaimer header the parent crate carries.
4. Add a dependency: PKIX-jbvb `depends on` PKIX-amgn.2 (target crate must exist) and PKIX-amgn.4 (BasicSmimeProfile must exist so the sub-profiles can compose atop it).

## Acceptance

- [ ] PKIX-jbvb title + description updated.
- [ ] Dependencies set correctly.
- [ ] Reference-not-authoritative framing in PKIX-jbvb's acceptance criteria.
- [ ] No structural conflict with PKIX-amgn.2 / .4 work.

## Out of scope

- Actually implementing the three S/MIME BR sub-profiles — that's PKIX-jbvb's job, just retargeted.

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.1 (stance), PKIX-amgn.2 (target crate exists).
title: Reparent PKIX-jbvb (S/MIME BR sub-profile families) to pkix-profiles-cabf with reference-not-authoritative framing
